statement: The kitchen holds what thirteen photographs of 13 November 2026 show and the seven things the owner named, and each is about the usual size for its kind
rationale: counted from photographs taken with nothing moved: things behind other things, in the dishwasher and in the closed drawers are not in the list; no size was measured; some labels could not be read

mechanism.how: Read the list of things on the marketing page against the cabinets and correct it; measure the stock pot, the stand mixer, the food processor, the blender, the Instant Pot and the longest baking sheet
